project.goal: Remotely operated four-wheel football robot intended to capture and move a ball into the goal; future claw tactics are concepts, not current firmware behavior.
project.hardware_context: Factory chassis and controller board. Remote wireless section was modified with signal enhancement and flying-wire module connection.
project.current_runtime: USART1 receives E49 keycodes; main loop maps independent throttle and steering axes into ramped four-wheel skid steering. TIM2 serves three arm joints plus gripper.

implementation_boundaries: PID_Cnotrol.c and Printf_DMA.c are included in the Keil project but not called by the current main loop. Current main initializes the three joints at absolute 0/0/0 and toggles only the gripper; further ball-handling arm motions are future work.

technical_route.facts: Captured interleaved two-byte keycodes. UART ISR writes a ring buffer; main loop parses with sliding resynchronization and per-key timestamps. Independent throttle/steering axes allow combined forward/turn. Invalid stream or UART fault clears key states.

technical_route.evidence: 个人笔记整理/关于电机驱动的思路.docx; New_zuqiu_PK/New_zuqiu_PK/User_BSP/BSP_Motor.h; New_zuqiu_PK/New_zuqiu_PK/User_BSP/BSP_Motor.c
technical_route.facts: Observed low-active approximately 20 ms PWM, aged neutral offset and dead zone. Implemented four-wheel neutral/polarity calibration, dead-zone compensation, skid-steer mixing, geometry-based inside-wheel scaling, balance, proportional normalization, and separate throttle/steering ramps.
Accepts ground-absolute angles for three links, converts them to local joint angles, then applies calibrated neutral and direction to TIM2 PWM. Gripper uses a separate raw CCR interface.

remote_signal_note: Long-press continuity depends on sender repeat interval and receiver key-state retention time. Intermittent pauses occurred, were temporarily addressed, and the owner plans to refactor remote-side code. Treat this as engineering history, not an open confirmation question.
historical_configuration_note: The 2026-09-09 E49 note shows a 434.5 MHz configuration snapshot; current BSP_433.c writes CHAN 0x3E, about 441 MHz by the module formula. Do not conflate historical notes with current firmware configuration.
